llms.body:
# Yango

> Yango transforms global technologies into localized everyday services for regional communities across 30+ countries in the Middle East, Latin America, Africa, Europe, and beyond. The company operates a digital ecosystem that includes ride-hailing, delivery, entertainment, and business solutions, adapting each service to meet unique local needs and cultural preferences. Yango partners with businesses to provide advanced tools for growth while investing in community development through education programs and career initiatives.

## Consumer Services

- [Home Page](https://yango.com/en_int/) — Company overview, mission, and key business areas.
- [Our Services](https://yango.com/en_int/our_services/) — Overview of all Yango services.
- [Yango Rides](https://yango.com/en_int/order/) — Ride-hailing app for fast, safe, and affordable rides. Get a car to your door in minutes with advanced tech.
- [Yango Maps](https://maps.yango.com/) — Easy city navigation; by car, public transport, or on foot. With real-time updates and integrated ride-hailing.
- [Yango Pay](https://apps.apple.com/ae/app/yango-taxi-food-delivery/id1437157286) — Handy e-wallet within the Yango app: easy top-ups, fee-free payments, and cashless transactions.
- [Yasmina AI assistant](https://yasmina.yango.com) — Human-like AI assistant fluent in Arabic and English, enhancing daily life and integrating with Yango apps.
- [Yango Play](https://play.yango.com) — AI-powered entertainment with video, music, and mini-games. Ad-free, and personalized for you.
- [Food Delivery](https://apps.apple.com/ae/app/yango-taxi-food-delivery/id1437157286) — Fast delivery from local stores, cafes, and restaurants, with real-time order tracking.
- [Buy & Sell](https://apps.apple.com/ae/app/yango-taxi-food-delivery/id1437157286) — Marketplace for consumers and businesses with secure payments, trusted sellers, and quick delivery.
- [Goya by Yango](https://apps.apple.com/ae/app/yango-taxi-food-delivery/id1437157286) — Premium ride-hailing brand for those seeking aesthetics. Spacious cars, top-tier drivers, and exclusive perks.
- [About Yango](https://yango.com/en_int/who_we_are) - Yango Group is a tech ecosystem that provides digital services designed to make everyday life easier.

## Business Services

- [Yango Ads](https://yango-ads.com/) — Tech-driven ads for businesses, reaching 3.8B users to drive impactful campaigns and growth opportunities.
- [Delivery & Logistics](https://yango.delivery/) — Parcel and goods delivery for individuals and businesses.
- [Yango Tech](https://yango-tech.com/) - B2B tech ecosystem combining warehousing and mobility solutions with AI tools for optimization and growth.
- [Yango Drive](https://drive.yango.com/) - Reliable car rental service with flexible options for business and leisure, from budget to luxury cars.
- [Yango Rides for business](https://apps.apple.com/ae/app/yango-taxi-food-delivery/id1437157286) — Manage corporate rides effortlessly with advanced tools, transparent documentation and dedicated support.
- [Yango for Business](https://business.yango.com) — Corporate rides, analytics, map integration.

Yango Tech

Yango transforms technologies into everyday services for local communities. Our tech ecosystem adapts and evolves to meet unique regional needs.

  • Operating across the Middle East, Latin America, Africa, Europe, and beyond.

    30+ countries

  • From mobility to entertainment - our products work together to make life more convenient and efficient.

    10+ services

  • Started as a ride-hailing app, we grew into a global digital ecosystem driving innovation worldwide.

    7+ years of experience

Global Yet Local

With a hyperlocal approach, we customize tech and services to fit local habits, languages, and communities globally.

Our impact

Our mission is to bridge the gap between leading world innovations and local communities, fostering connections and enhancing everyday living experiences.

GROUP CHAT

Every guest here is from Yango Group: regional leaders, top managers, and creators shaping our ecosystem and daily life in their markets. Each has a unique path — and that is why they are here, to share insights, stories, and lessons from building tech

Watch nowWatch now

Empowering business

Our partnership model equips businesses with advanced tools for growth by optimizing logistics, digital infrastructure, and customer engagement. We support business scaling, which in turn creates jobs and strengthens local economies. Through collaboration, we build self-sustaining business ecosystems that fuel social development and advance global technological innovation.

Community investment

We invest in the well-being of communities by creating opportunities for growth, learning, and connection. Through initiatives like the Yango Fellowship Program and partnerships with the Zambian National STEM Foundation, we support education with access to IT clubs, modern classrooms, and mentorship. Our career programs, including internships and coaching, help bridge knowledge gaps and empower future innovators.

Social impact

Discover Yango Group’s first Impact Report, showcasing how we’re reimagining life across 30+ countries. From STEM education to safety innovations, explore how our technology shapes lives.
